A Must-Visit for Cơm Tấm Lovers! - Michelin Selected in HCMC
Mar 2025 • Couples
If you’re a fan of Vietnamese broken rice, Cơm Tấm Ba Ghiền is a must-visit! This place truly lives up to its reputation, and it’s no surprise that it’s Michelin-selected.

The highlight of the meal was the grilled pork chop (sườn)—massive (about 400-500g before grilling), juicy, tender, and packed with flavor. The portion was so generous that I struggled to finish it! 
*Note: a bigger size of the grilled pork chop is available upon request.

My husband and I ordered the combination plate “thập cẩm” and the grilled pork chop, shredded pork & skin pork, steamed egg cake “sườn bì chả” plate, along with a bowl of soup. Every bite was delicious and satisfying. Our meal cost 306,000 VND, which was well worth it for the quality and portion sizes.

Service was super fast and efficient, even though the place was packed by 6 PM. Be prepared for a crowd, as they don’t take reservations. If you’re riding a motorcycle, there’s free parking, but note that car parking is not available before 6 PM.

Overall, an amazing local food experience with authentic flavors and great value. Highly recommend!

Cơm tấm “Broken Rice” Heaven - Michelin Selected
Sep 2024 • Friends
I came here for a late lunch with a Saigonese friend who eats here regularly. This was my first experience of Cơm Tấm Ba Ghiền. Incredibly tasty pork & chicken dishes served up with broken rice. 

This place from the outside just looks like one of tens of thousands of local kerb side restaurants dotted around Saigon’s districts. This one has been serving the same recipe for over 30 years and is now Michelin listed. The marinade sauce is the secret ... delicious savoury/sweetness, simply wow! 

Side note, the servings are large! We both had difficulty finishing even though the food was incredibly tasty. Our huge lunch for two including two drinks … came to a nominal total cost only 296k VND = $17.50 Australian!!! Good luck at eating such a delicious, Michelin rated lunch for that amount of money for two anywhere else in the world! 

If you are visiting tourists well worth leaving the comfort of your 5 star District 1 hotel and hopping into a Grab car and heading over for a late lunch. Be warned, no such thing as bookings; cash only payments; and after 5pm it is absolutely packed I am told.

Simple, Delicous, and Favor packed
Aug 2022 • Friends
There are 6 options to choose from. We opted for #6 which has everything that store can fit onto a plate. 
The rice plate or Com Tam consists of broken rice, chinese sausages, caramelized marinated charcoaled pork chops, egg custard, pork cracker (fried pig's skins), a fried yolky egg, and pickled juliend rabbish and carrots (Yes, its that much into one plate). Everything on the plate was perfectly excuted along with the aroma of pork chops being grilled wasping into the restuarant. The Com Tam itself came out to be 130k per plate (roughtly $5.5), its definately more expensive than other back alley stands which usally costs around 60k-80k ($2.5-$3.5). That being said if you're just craving a heartful of joy on a plate, this restuarant might just be the one.

Delicious!
Sep 2016 • Couples
Fine dining it ain't. Authentic tasty local food experience it is. 

We walked here on a rainy night battling the weather, crumbling footpaths, and noisy oh-so-close traffic... and it was all truly worth it!

For a genuine local street food experience, Com Tam Ba Ghien can't be beaten. For about A$2 (about the same for a cold Tiger beer), you'll get soft boiled broken rice (smaller than usual rice morsels), delicious dipping sauce, and a scrumptious slab of charcoal grilled marinated pork. Heavenly flavours and textures!

But it's more than just the food... it's also about the authentic Vietnamese eating experience. 

Charcoal cooker and cooking is done at the front of the restaurant by bandana clad grannies. The generations of family and friends are all there. Younger mums bring their wide-eyed babies and toddlers over to say hello and give you a high five. Any one appears to help out if needed, though those officially on duty proudly wear their blue 'Com Tam Ba Ghien' t-shirts. The food is dished up on plastic plates while you sit on plastic chairs at steel tables under a colourful neon sign proudly highlighting the restaurant name. The road brimming with cars and motorbikes is right in front of you as the restaurant is all open to the street. It seemed like every second motorbike would pull up right next to the charcoal cooker and buy their dinner takeaway. 

Ahh... Vietnam.

Best Broken Rice (Com Tam) in Ho Chi Minh
Dec 2015 • Couples
Located near the airport which is about 20 min cab ride from District 1, this is a local Vietnamese eatery outlet which serve broken rice with grilled pork, and one of the best in Ho Chi Minh itself. The place is a little hard to find as it is a local eatery found in one of the small street. However, if you have access to internet, you can locate it on google maps using the address provided. It is mostly listed on blog recommendations and you can easily google about it to read more of the reviews.

Almost no english is spoken here but given that there is only 1 dish here, it is relatively easy to order. You can simply show the staff that you want to order "Cơm tấm bì chả sườn trứng ốp la". This is broken rice with grilled pork, steamed egg with pork, shreds of pork and some vegetables. Definitely a must-have if you are into local Vietnamese food and we were surprised that it was not listed on Trip Advisor yet.
